title: Exact-SKU physical count observation domain
decision: Create physical-count evidence before physical reconciliation.
reason: No canonical physical-count observation exists. Existing physical inventory movements are asserted batch/SKU corrections, while FOOD-006P validates recorded evidence generation but explicitly grants neither physical reconciliation nor current-QOH authority.
countSemantics: countedPackageCount is a nonnegative safe integer; zero is valid.
scopeSemantics: exact-sku-total is a caller assertion that the observation is a total count for the exact SKU rather than a partial batch/location count. Structural validation does not authenticate or prove that assertion.
timeSemantics: observedAt is caller-supplied canonical UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ evidence. It is not a generated clock and does not establish continued currentness.
batchRelationship: No batch field. FOOD-006Q records exact-SKU total count evidence so a later reconciliation slice can compare like-for-like against FOOD-006P exact-SKU recorded balance. Per-batch reconciliation remains separate.
reconciliation: Deferred. A later slice may consume one canonical FOOD-006Q observation plus compatible authoritative FOOD-006P recorded-balance evidence and derive agreement/discrepancy without mutating either source.
